column1: # testees/pcrec/list_definitions.tsv -- pcrec's DEFINITIONS TABLE at the pin
# (the FIFTH registry surface, [DD-11] / pcrec D85, docs/spec/registry.md
# 9), archived VERBATIM under a source header. Everything below this header
# 2026-08-31 by lane b22repin ([B22]). 50 data rows / 7 columns: kind,
# selector, syntax, order, predicate, definition, applies -- one row per
# construct DEFINED in terms of another (`\d` = `[0-9]`, the POSIX classes,
# `\R`, the `\c`/`\x`/`\o` decoders as text functions), the predicate being
# the option-scope tag's own name (a closed vocabulary). BYTE-IDENTICAL to
# the 96e44c2 copy below the header: no definition moved between the pins.
# The grep strips pcrec's own `#` comment/header lines, so the data rows
# are the whole body; the column header is restated here for a reader:
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR: nothing the adapter reads depends on it (the
# emitted code is unchanged by [DD-11]); it is archived beside
# list_axes.tsv under the same rule -- `make check-harness` diffs it against
# the pin's live output (`check_list_definitions_registry`), so a definition
# pcrec adds or changes between pins is a named diff here rather than an
# unexplained answer change in a record. Re-archive at every re-pin.
